# Stress Lifecycle

## 4. Requirements

### FR-MCP-807 — Draft active target blocker

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | functional |
| Target | v2.3.0 |
| Status | planned |
| Priority | medium |
| Risk | low |
| Stability | draft |

#### Requirement

The stress fixture must warn when draft requirements are in the active target.

#### Rationale

Agents must not implement draft requirements without explicit override.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Draft active-target warnings are emitted.

### FR-MCP-808 — Verified draft lifecycle error

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | functional |
| Target | v2.3.0 |
| Status | verified |
| Priority | high |
| Risk | low |
| Stability | draft |

#### Requirement

The stress fixture must reject verified requirements that remain draft.

#### Rationale

Verified and draft lifecycle states are contradictory.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: Verified draft requirements are invalid.

| --- | --- |
| Type | functional |
| Target | v2.3.0 |
| Status | planned |

#### Requirement

The stress fixture must warn when frozen requirements lack real change notes.

#### Rationale

Frozen requirements require explicit audit history.
